why: Widens the dead-end budget's threshold to `corridorAreaFraction`'s, making the new measure a duplicate of the blunt proxy issue #822 says it replaces. `corridorAreaFraction` collapses a straight lane with two exits and a pocket with one into the same bucket; `deadEndAreaFraction` is the same 8-ray probe one bucket narrower, and that one bucket is the entire measure. Run manually before this entry existed: the mutation fails 4 of the 42 tests in measure.test.ts, including the control pair of boards that carry IDENTICAL wall cells arranged as a blind alley and as bars enclosing nothing -- the pair on which `corridorAreaFraction` moves the wrong way (0.028 against 0.067) while the dead-end figure roughly doubles (0.0052 against 0.0027).
killedBy: mapgen quality measures: the dead-end budget (issue #822) separates a pocket from bars of identical wall area, where corridorAreaFraction does not
